units.source_text: 另一方面，我憎恨母亲无法想像的野心，但它却把我俘虏了。

en.t: On the other hand, I hated my mother's unimaginable ambition, yet it had captured me.

units.source_text: 父亲一言不发，也许他是在和母亲同样的野心的驱使下，才把我送到这寺庙里来的吧。

en.t: My father said nothing; perhaps he too was driven by the same ambition as my mother when he brought me to this temple.

units.source_text: 田山道诠法师是个独身汉。

en.t: The priest Tayama Dosen was a bachelor.

units.source_text: 如果法师本人是受前代法师的嘱托而继承鹿苑寺的话，

en.t: If the priest himself had inherited Rokuonji at the request of the previous priest,

units.source_text: 那么只要我有心，也许就有可能被推定为法师的继承人。

en.t: then, as long as I wished it, I might possibly be regarded as the priest's successor.

units.source_text: 果真如此，金阁将属于我的了！

en.t: If that were really so, the Golden Pavilion would belong to me!
